answer: The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in dawn, expire in nadir, and ferrous lists each expiry. Anyone running 23 aliases therefore needs 158 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2594 identities would post 1495 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
